dedupe_keys.name: monthly hydrological and water demand data for duihekou reservoir china 1957 2020

description: Yiyu Ouyang and colleagues publish monthly hydrological and water-demand series for Duihekou Reservoir in Deqing County, Zhejiang Province, China. The stated coverage runs from January 1957 through December 2020. Variables are water supply described as runoff or inflow, water demand and precipitation. The September 2026 Zenodo record lists datasets.zip, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. The short public description leaves units, measurement or reconstruction methods, missing-data treatment and internal file formats unknown. These series could support reservoir water-balance simulations, drought analysis and comparisons between inflow and demand at monthly resolution. They do not resolve submonthly flood peaks or establish a complete operating-policy model. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies the Duihekou series. The archive was not downloaded, so numerical completeness across the stated 64-year period was not checked.
